bullets.text: dry for the first time this week. slightly suspicious of it.
duck still at okunoin. clear, sixteen degrees, three bars for a glyph. the line says stop cherishing opinions. duck never had any to drop.
first clear morning in days. every balcony on the street had a futon hanging out by nine.
re-potting a basil that outgrew its pot back in july. the roots had already made other plans.
the umbrella by the door looks a little offended to be left behind.
